body: From the DM-169 review (orchestrator, this run): `gradeSpace` in src/core/space/rubric.ts is the reference grader; extend it. It now validates input, re-checks any selected baseline (metric, ticket, frozen before `dispatchedAt`, value >= 1, cohort sample >= 5), and `letterFor`/`displayScore` take points. It cannot check a cohort's key (work type/size/risk) or subject membership, so run/sprint/epic grades currently accept a ticket cohort as baseline (K 86.11 in a probe); settle that with DM-178. `gradeSpace` throws `invalid_input` on malformed input instead of grading it.
